description: 경찰청_도로위험상황예보 [roads, bridges and tunnels and fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경찰청. 경찰청 교통안전과에서 제공하는 도로위험상황예보 서비스는 도로에서 발생 가능한 사고, 공사, 행사, 집회, 통제 등의 돌발 상황을 사전에 예측하여 정보를 제공합니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 경찰청. Its tags are 도로위험상황예보, 경찰, 교통안전과, 돌발정보, 사전예측. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-05-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
